name: Wolfenstein 3D Raycasting
definition: A technique that projects a 2D grid map into a 3D perspective viewport by casting individual rays from the player's coordinate vectors across their Field of View (FOV). It computes the distance to a wall hit and uses that distance to determine the height of the wall segment rendered on screen, building 3D perspective using basic 2D line rendering.
summary: Wolfenstein 3D Raycasting renders 3D corridors on 2D grids by casting one ray per column and using perpendicular distance to correct fisheye distortion, distinguishing it from general voxel methods.
